paragraphs.source_en: Imagawa Yoshimoto hated to perspire. As he had a page fan him, he listened to Matsudaira Motoyasu with an intense gaze. Motoyasu had already fathered Takechiyo, who could inherit the Matsudaira legacy. It was finally decided that his symbolic first battle would take place outside Terabe Castle. Yoshimoto was quite pleased with all this. He wanted to see just how capable Motoyasu would prove as commander of the vanguard. In other words, this campaign was a rehearsal for the decisive battle that would precede the march on the capital.
